tools.name: find_document
tools.description: Resolve a user's country and document into the slug the other tools take. Pass the words the user used ('India passport', 'Schengen visa', 'UK passport digital', '2x2'). Returns JSON text with up to 5 matches, each with 'slug' (use it for get_photo_spec and get_make_link), the country, the document

tools.name: get_photo_spec
tools.description: The official photo requirements of one document: print size in mm and inches, pixel size, digital file limits, head height and eye line as percentages of the photo height, background, glasses, expression, head covering, photo age, the authority's own guidance on photos taken at home, the source URL

tools.name: get_make_link
tools.description: A link that opens the photo tool for one document, so the user takes or uploads the photo on their own device. The photo is processed privately in the user's browser and is never sent through this connection: never ask the user for the photo here. Returns JSON text with 'url' (give it to the user),

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Every country in the dataset with its ISO code, slug, number of documents and the URL of its page. Returns JSON text (about 12 KB) with 'count', 'countries' and an 'attribution' line. Use find_document instead when the user already named a country.
